decisions.decision: Key BoardView on board.id in BoardScreen instead of resetting scrollLeft in an effect
decisions.rationale: React's own 'reset state with a key'; a fresh scroll row starts at 0 and board-scoped modal state cannot follow the user across boards. No bookkeeping added (CLAUDE.md platform-primitive rule).

decisions.decision: Set TanStack notifyManager scheduler to queueMicrotask globally (docs/adr/tech/0034), not per-hook flushSync or override state
decisions.rationale: Measured: the default setTimeout(0) scheduler lets dnd-kit's synchronous drop render paint before the optimistic reorder reaches useQuery. TanStack's own knob; 0029 shapes forbidden.

decisions.decision: Placeholder subtasks are retired by owned client ids then re-inserted from result.created, never paired by index
decisions.rationale: createChildrenSerially skips failed titles, so created and typed titles are not index-aligned after a partial failure.
